title: 'A lot of Ukrainians are feeling extremely betrayed' by Trump's Russian diesel deal
summary: Reporting from central Ukraine, FRANCE 24's Gulliver Cragg says that "a lot of Ukrainians are feeling extremely betrayed by a country that until recently they saw not only as an ally but as a beacon of freedom and democracy, a country whose values they should aspire to.
